stai.definition: State-Trait Anxiety Inventory: supplied total index of anxiety.
stai.source_basis: Supplied session JSON; explanatory annotations distinguish standard task concepts from missing protocol details.
stai.caveat: State versus trait subscale, form and scoring are unspecified. Standard Form Y has separate 20-item state and trait scales; no clinical cutoff or reliable change is applied.

pswq.definition: Penn State Worry Questionnaire: dispositional tendency toward persistent worry.
pswq.source_basis: Supplied session JSON; explanatory annotations distinguish standard task concepts from missing protocol details.
pswq.caveat: The original PSWQ has 16 items; the case dictionary does not document language/version or item scoring. Do not infer a diagnosis from this total.

erq_reappraisal.definition: ERQ cognitive reappraisal: habitual reinterpretation of a situation to alter emotional impact.
erq_reappraisal.source_basis: Supplied session JSON; explanatory annotations distinguish standard task concepts from missing protocol details.
erq_reappraisal.direction_text: Higher generally indicates greater use of reappraisal, not universally better regulation.
erq_reappraisal.caveat: Standard ERQ distinguishes reappraisal and suppression. Source aggregation, translation and item-level scoring are unavailable; reported values are retained as supplied.

erq_suppression.definition: ERQ expressive suppression: habitual inhibition of outward emotional expression.
erq_suppression.source_basis: Supplied session JSON; explanatory annotations distinguish standard task concepts from missing protocol details.
erq_suppression.direction_text: Higher generally indicates greater use of suppression; effects depend on context.
erq_suppression.caveat: Not a global emotion-regulation or mental-health score; source aggregation and item scoring are not documented.

erq_processing.definition: Emotion Regulation Questionnaire — processing subscale (source label).
erq_processing.source_basis: Supplied session JSON; explanatory annotations distinguish standard task concepts from missing protocol details.
erq_processing.caveat: These are not the two standard Gross-John ERQ subscale names. Items, scoring and relationship to the standard ERQ are unknown; preserve the labels without asserting construct validity.

erq_expression.definition: Emotion Regulation Questionnaire — expression subscale (source label).
erq_expression.source_basis: Supplied session JSON; explanatory annotations distinguish standard task concepts from missing protocol details.

loneliness.definition: UCLA Loneliness Scale: subjective perceived social disconnection.
loneliness.source_basis: Supplied session JSON; explanatory annotations distinguish standard task concepts from missing protocol details.
loneliness.caveat: Scale version and language are unspecified. Loneliness differs from objective social isolation or relationship status and is not a dedicated health-related QoL measure.

marital_status.source_basis: Supplied session JSON; explanatory annotations distinguish standard task concepts from missing protocol details.
marital_status.direction_text: Descriptive context; no universal favourable direction.
marital_status.caveat: Cohabiting does not quantify relationship quality, support or household composition.

education_level.source_basis: Supplied session JSON; explanatory annotations distinguish standard task concepts from missing protocol details.
education_level.direction_text: Descriptive context; no universal favourable direction.
education_level.caveat: The 1-9 level-to-qualification mapping is absent; code 3 is not interpreted as years of schooling or a named qualification.

employment.source_basis: Supplied session JSON; explanatory annotations distinguish standard task concepts from missing protocol details.
employment.direction_text: Descriptive context; no universal favourable direction.
employment.caveat: Sick leave may reflect treatment, recovery, job demands or policy; it is not a direct disability, cognition or QoL score.

sport_freq_per_week.direction_text: Descriptive context; no universal favourable direction.
sport_freq_per_week.caveat: The TSV contains 0 in both sessions. The postoperative 0 is displayed as supplied; the explicit sport_vs_preop field separately records Same. Duration/intensity are unknown.

smoking.source_basis: Supplied session JSON; explanatory annotations distinguish standard task concepts from missing protocol details.
smoking.direction_text: Descriptive context; no universal favourable direction.
